1 فَدَخَ رَأْسَهُ , aor.
فَدَخَ , (K, TA,) inf. n. فَدْخٌ, (TA,) He broke his head with a stone: (K, TA:) and فَدَخْتُ الشَّىْءَ I broke the thing: (TA:) [but] the verb is not used except in relation to a thing in which is moisture. (K, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
